endpoints.chat_note: One public doorbell for the whole network. The door does not name a node: each request resolves a covering block chain through the libp2p hivemind DHT, so the answer may come from any node serving the model — and the door keeps working when individual nodes go down. Run one 'kwaainet shard api' behind TLS to serve it locally; the chain is picked per request, not per manifest.

auth.peer_identity: send the hive's brand as the bearer token (e.g. 'kwaai' or 'hive:kwaai') to be recorded in the peer's ledger as 'hive:kwaai'
auth.note: The door accepts anonymous requests; a recognised bearer identifies the calling hive for accounting and rate limiting. No secret is required to ring the doorbell.

discovery.state: https://map.kwaai.ai/api/v1/state — every online node and the blocks it serves; the doorbell resolves a chain from this
discovery.note: The two doors must serve identical content. This file is the single source of truth; the copy in the KwaaiNetMap repo is generated from it.

note: Ships in-git because www.kwaai.ai is Google Sites and cannot serve /.well-known files. Copy to kwaai.ai/.bridge/hivv.json when a file-serving host fronts the domain.
